# polymarket fixtures

- `activity_trades_20261009.json` -- recorded 2026-10-09 from public endpoint `GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/activity` params={'user': '0x124628e686db22da39b6ee43ca786c8a074bd6f2', 'type': 'TRADE', 'limit': '1000', 'sort_direction': 'ASC', 'start': '1788621345', 'end': '1788621358'} by scripts/record_fixture.py; re-record from a real account when one exists.
- `activity_redeems_20261009.json` -- recorded 2026-10-09 from public endpoint `GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/activity` params={'user': '0x124628e686db22da39b6ee43ca786c8a074bd6f2', 'type': 'REDEEM', 'limit': '1000', 'sort_direction': 'ASC', 'start': '1788712054', 'end': '1788712174'} by scripts/record_fixture.py; re-record from a real account when one exists.
- `positions_20261009.json` -- recorded 2026-10-09 from public endpoint `GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/positions` params={'user': '0x6f09fbcaee0a468a4ad9e1174c88f1a90b456c6c', 'limit': '1000'} by scripts/record_fixture.py; re-record from a real account when one exists.
- `leaderboard_week_20261014.json` -- recorded 2026-10-14 from public endpoint `GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/leaderboard` params={'time_period': 'week', 'limit': '1000'}; trimmed to the first 30 rows and **anonymised**: every `user_id` replaced by a synthetic `0x00..0N` (N = row number), every `user_name` by `placeholder-name-N`, non-empty `x_username` by `placeholder-handle-N` and non-empty `profile_image` by `https://example.invalid/placeholder.png` (the fields stay so tests prove the connector drops them); `pagination.limit` set to 30; rank, pnl, volume, verified and the cursor verbatim.
- `user_volume_20261022.json`, `value_20261022.json`, `user_stats_20261022.json` -- recorded 2026-10-22 from public endpoints `GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/{user-volume,value,user-stats}` for one leaderboard wallet (user-volume with start=1792195200&end=1792800000); `proxy_wallet` replaced by the synthetic `0x00..a1`; user-stats trimmed to the fields the connector reads plus `views` and a stub `all_time_pnl` (the fields stay so tests prove they are ignored).
